messages.author: b0084e74319ebcb3
messages.subject: pCountOpen or pCount?
parts:
Hello all,
I wanted to ask your opinion regarding the type of analyses I should do for a repeated transect data set. I have data for two years of transects, and each year each transect was repeated four times within a few days. Therefore it would be fair to assume that I can treat this as 'closed populations'. However, few of the transects (14 out of 72) were repeated also in both years (observer varied between years). Should I just use pCountOpen? or would it be better to treat the transects as different each year? I am not sure because only a small fraction of the transects were repeated among years. Do you have any suggestions? Thank you all very much for your time and help.
Best,
Laura

messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] pCountOpen or pCount?
parts:
hi Laura,
 I think you can use pcountOpen for this, it fits the Dail-Madsen model.  The data structure accommodates repeated binomial counts within years (secondary periods within primary periods) see ?unmarkedFramePCO
 The model should still work if not all transects were repeated across years... although where the model starts to breakdown would be worth evaluating by simulation.

regards
andy
